record_purpose: Record the R4 source slice that blocks release publication until a versioned, digest-bound candidate gate map is complete. This file is an enforcement receipt, not an instance of the lapis-release-candidate-gates gate map that release consumes; it carries no gates, so release --candidate-gate-map must never be pointed at it.

source.revision_role: committed baseline containing the first review-repair pass
source.review_repair_state: The deduplicated, non-outdated PR #88 review repairs were applied as a dirty working tree on the named committed baseline. files_changed names the complete dirty set; files_hashed names the non-receipt files whose SHA-256 values are recorded here. The companion binding receipt hashes this receipt and those same files; the follow-up commit preserves both receipt files, so neither embeds its own digest.

scope: This receipt covers source enforcement and focused Python checks only. It does not build, verify, notarize, package, publish, download, install, or qualify a candidate.
implementation: Package manifest candidate gate-map schema 1 requires downloaded-asset, notarized staged verification, fresh-user Finder launch, installed Sparkle update with live sessions, update-failure recovery, and registry/history migration rollback receipts.

Each gate binds source revision, version, app and DMG artifact hashes, the applicable appcast digest where required, the receipt digest and path inside the map, an explicit UTC date-time, a command, zero exit status, and a passing scope. The bound map also records its own byte digest.

The explicit package_macos.py appcast --tag vX.Y.Z command rejects a tag that does not equal v plus the project version, writes the stable feed after the DMG is stapled and before receipts are collected, and release verifies that feed signature and length against the staged DMG without rewriting it.

Opening preflight skips appcast-specific gate identity checks until final preflight supplies the appcast. Replacing covered app or DMG bytes, weakening notarization, or changing the covered appcast revokes gate approval while retaining prior receipts as evidence; a first appcast binding without prior gate coverage also revokes.

Opening preflight validates candidate-map schema, kind, digest, entry shape, and exact gate names before final preflight supplies the appcast. Replacing covered app or DMG bytes, weakening notarization, or changing the covered appcast revokes gate approval while retaining prior receipts as evidence; a first appcast binding without prior gate coverage also revokes.

bind_candidate_gates replaces any failed, revoked, or partially failed binding without a flag, accepts an identical approved binding, requires release --replace-candidate-gates for a different approved map, revalidates the complete replacement, and retains every superseded value, including a malformed previous binding, as evidence.
The companion r4-candidate-gate-map-binding receipt binds this receipt's bytes; neither receipt embeds its own hash.
